newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S VAAL, BLOEMHOF DAMS WATER LEVELS RISE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S VAAL, BLOEMHOF DAMS WATER LEVELS RISE.

text.p: South African Water and Forestry officials on Wednesday advised residents of low lying areas around the Vaal and Bloemhof dams to exercise caution as water levels triggered by unseasonal rains continued to rise.
They said the Vaal Dam was currently 116 percent full and its water level was expected to peak by about 122 percent over its designed capacity on May 30.

"The outflow (of the Vaal Dam) will be increased...due to the rising water level," the Department of Water Affairs and Forestry said in a statement, adding seven sluice gates had already been opened at the dam.
It said the current capacity of the Bloemhof Dam was at 110 percent with the ouflow expected to peak on Thursday.
